tool.name: list_files_local
tool.description:
List files in a directory, optionally filtered by glob pattern.
Used in the fix proposal phase to locate source files before reading them for diff drafting. Returns file paths relative to the given root, with sizes in bytes. Only files are returned — directories are excluded.

parameter.name: path
parameter.description: Absolute path to the directory to list.

parameter.name: pattern
parameter.description: Glob pattern to filter results (default "**/*"). Examples: "**/*.go", "**/*.java", "internal/**/*.go", "*.md".

returns.description: {success, root, pattern, count, files: [{path, size_bytes}], truncated}. Capped at 1000 entries.

tool.name: read_source_file
tool.description:
Read a source file with line numbers prepended.
Used in the fix proposal phase to read the exact lines flagged by a finding, providing context for drafting a correct unified diff.
start_line and end_line are 1-based and inclusive. end_line=0 reads to EOF. Max 500 KB per call — use start_line/end_line for large files.

parameter.name: file_path
parameter.description: Absolute path to the source file to read.

parameter.name: end_line
parameter.description: Last line to read, 1-based inclusive. 0 = read to EOF (default).

returns.description: {success, file_path, total_lines, start_line, end_line, content (with line numbers)}.

tool.name: search_files_local
tool.description:
Search file contents by regex pattern across a directory tree.
Used in the fix proposal phase to find all callers or usages of a vulnerable function before writing a fix, ensuring the unified diff addresses every affected call site.
Returns matching lines with file path and line number. Max 500 results.

parameter.name: path
parameter.description: Absolute path to the directory to search in.

parameter.name: pattern
parameter.description: Regular expression pattern to search for (Python re syntax).

parameter.name: file_glob
parameter.description: Glob pattern to restrict which files are searched (default "**/*"). Examples: "**/*.go", "**/*.java", "internal/**/*.go".

returns.description: {success, root, pattern, count, matches: [{file, line, content}], truncated}.
